equations: unforced 2D ideal-gas compressible Euler in standard physical-time conservative form
coordinates: X=x-U_inf_x*t, Y=y-U_inf_y*t, wrapped to [-10,10) by minimum image
physical_time_derivative: q_t=-U_inf_x*q_x-U_inf_y*q_y, evaluated by analytic primitive/conservative chain rule
cell_reference: Tensor Gauss quadrature of all four conserved variables. Compare order8 and16; primitive pressure and velocity are computed AFTER quadrature of q. Mean primitive pressure is a different quantity.
continuous_exactness_scope: The translating vortex is an exact whole-plane Euler solution. The finite periodic minimum-image field has nonzero Gaussian tails at seams and is not a globally exact smooth periodic solution. At halfwidth10 and this short time, velocity tails are extremely small but the qualification remains.
same_physical_family: At p_inf=1 this formula recovers the historical KEEP beta3, background(1,.5), L20 vortex. The low-Mach additions change background pressure and density/pressure perturbations consistently, not pressure alone.
independence: Analytic/reference implementation imports neither primary fluxes nor Numart. No external PDE engine or reference PDE is executed.
